editorial:
Imagine taking a road trip with your friends to a house where a real-life mass murder happened years ago. That is exactly what happens here. You follow three high school kids who love hunting ghosts and chasing urban legends. They head to Villisca, Iowa, to visit the famous Moore House. The vibe starts off like a typical teen adventure, but it quickly turns into a nightmare when they decide to sneak back into the house after dark. You will feel the tension build as they realize they are not alone in those creepy rooms.

The acting feels natural, and the jump scares are timed well enough to keep you on edge. While the plot is a bit simple, the atmosphere makes it work. If you like movies where teens get into trouble in spooky places, you will enjoy this one. It is a great pick for a movie night with friends.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a shocking twist. You find out that the ghosts are not just memories, but active killers. The teens realize they cannot simply escape the house because the spirits have trapped them. In the final scenes, the ghost of the original killer targets the group. Most of the characters meet a grim end as the cycle of violence repeats itself, leaving the house hungry for more victims.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves ghost stories and urban legends.
